notes.title: Patch 1.0.3d out! 32bit support and translations!
notes.notes:
Aside from minor bug and typo fixed, newest version of HEADLINER adds a 32bit support for Windows and Linux! If you run into any issues, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/680980/discussions/0/1519260397799695239/]post in the forums and let me know[/url], but it all should be working as far as the testing I've done :)

The bigger change introduces support for unofficial translations! So if you want to see HEADLINER in your language, now you can :D 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/680980/discussions/0/1699416432421990273/]Grab the files and read the full tutorial here![/url]

Hope to see HEADLINER in some new languages!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29997458/653f4632340098bba1d19f446830b212df8fe0fd.jpg[/img]

Once again [b]thanks to [url=https://fluffy.itch.io/]fluffy[/url][/b] for lending me their Macbook Mini and making the Mac version happen :) And thanks to all the previous tester for re-confirming the new version works!

notes.title: First Patch Out & Breaking 1K Sales!
notes.notes:
Just pushed the first post-launch update, in time to celebrate passing the first 1000 sales, woo! 

[h1][b]Please share and tweet around, keep the #FakeNews going![/b]

[b]Let's Make Gaming Great Again™ ;D[/b][/h1]

Kudos to Nelson, aves78, Lacie and Boxy_Snail for pointing out a few typos and suggestions!

[b]Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] [FEATURE] Added setting to disable tutorial for multiple playthrus
[*] [BUG] Fixed a Day 6 convo bug that didn't set spouse's face correctly
[*] [WRITING] Fixed typos (No more pursit kids, should't)
[*] [WRITING] Minor text update to checkpoint
[*] [WRITING] Fixed he/she typo on Day 2 Convo (She seemed frazzled lately) and in ending text (treated her illness)
[/list]

Lastly, [b]Big Thanks to Chilled Chaos, WeaselZone and Mr. Falcon[/b] for Lets Playing the game, and all of YOU who helped spread the word! 

[h1][b]I really appreciate the support :)[/b][/h1]
